delivered: AssetPlan snapshots quality/pool/detail-layer catalogs and chunk references without engine, DOM, timer or host-clock dependencies.
Layer filtering precedes explicit prefab LOD and quality-by-LOD texture selection. Shared content is coalesced by kind/bundle/path; two-level models can repeat the far address.

Default 5000ms grace uses an injected monotonic clock. Repeated out-of-view updates preserve the original deadline; reentry cancels expiry; flush services stationary views; close drains immediately and permanently.
Immutable per-acquisition tokens fence stale completions and failures. reject permits same-viewport retries; loading/cancellation/ref ownership remain with AssetLease and the View.
Catalog shape, missing cells, unknown references, ambiguous prefab layers and invalid clocks are rejected without silently falling back or mutating active ownership.

referenceApi.note: No new engine API in the pure plan. Real loading/refcount evidence reuses SC3-B1; cc.d.ts 3.8.8 addRef/decRef lines 28821/28832.
